programme_name: Cross-trait portability of family context in phylogenetic trait memory

relationship_to_prior_work.new_estimand: Predictive portability of family context to a completely held-out trait.
relationship_to_prior_work.role: Post-outcome complementary prediction analysis; cannot replace or reclassify any prior primary result.

biological_question: Does family identity carry a memory-loss signature that generalizes to a trait not used to estimate that family's context?

mirror_to_existing_trait_portability.existing_null: permute rho among trait labels within each family
mirror_to_existing_trait_portability.new_null: permute rho among family labels within each trait

procedure: For each held-out trait t, train on all systems whose trait is not t.
For each held-out system (f,t), predict rho using the arithmetic mean rho of family f among all training traits.
Baseline prediction for every held-out system is the arithmetic mean rho across all training systems.
Pool squared prediction errors over every held-out system exactly once.
portability_statistic.direction: positive values mean family context improves prediction of an unseen trait
portability_statistic.weighting: one family x trait system = one observation; no family, trait, species-count, or precision weights
portability_statistic.minimum_training_family_replicates: guaranteed >=1 by final core family degree >=2 and leave-one-trait-out design

permutation_test.null: Within each trait independently, permute observed rho values among that trait's fixed family labels. This preserves each trait's response distribution and the exact family-trait incidence graph while destroying cross-trait family correspondence.

prune_only_requirement.rule: Repeat the identical leave-trait-out statistic and within-trait blocked permutation using prune-only rho. A robust family-context portability claim requires gain>0 and p<=0.05 on both S3 and prune-only.

known_truth_gate.graph: exact 201-edge family-trait incidence, no real rho
known_truth_gate.failure_rule: If power or false-positive calibration fails, stop this complementary test; do not change the graph, benchmark, statistic, alpha, or permutation structure.

interpretation.positive: Family context learned from other traits predicts a completely held-out trait better than a training-set global mean, supporting cross-trait portability of lineage context.
interpretation.null: The estimated family component is repeatable within the observed crossed matrix but does not robustly transport to an unseen trait under this criterion.
interpretation.nonclaim: A positive result would not imply family effects dominate trait effects or identify a biological mechanism.
